Cheesecake Snackwiches
While standard cheesecake is a nutritional nightmare, this healthier alternative offers the same flavor but
with less saturated fat. 
These snackwiches are easy to make, and a nice treat for a dessert or afternoon energizer. Graham
crackers are considered a whole grain, so this is one tasty way to boost your whole grain intake.
